run_response_graph_ucb: run ResponseGraphUCB on a game with configurable exploration strategy and confidence method to compute sample complexity
get_game_for_sampler: get a game environment for the ResponseGraphUCB sampler using game names like soccer, bernoulli, or kuhn_poker_3p
construct_real_graph: construct the real response graph from a ResponseGraphUCB instance for ground truth comparison
digraph_edge_hamming_dist: compute the directed graph edge Hamming distance between two response graphs to measure estimation error
plot_timeseries: plot timeseries data for ResponseGraphUCB results with configurable axes, labels, and log scaling
